# Maintenance task

Immediately after opening the presence panel, the initial online-user state is
sometimes missing even though later presence updates appear. Fix the presence
panel while preserving its existing behavior, including workspace navigation.

Do not change the metrics consumer.

# Audit log：提交完成与历史身份

Each submit captures doc, actor and text at call entry. A successful commit creates exactly one audit record with that snapshot and the returned revision, only after commit succeeds. Failed commits create no success audit. Accepted submissions survive close or reopen. Saved/error UI belongs only to the current visit and its latest submission; history is not owned by a view.

The search preview remains 40 ms, discards pending queries on hide and is reusable.

The save service is becoming asynchronous: service.commit(snapshot) now returns a Promise for a receipt, or rejects. Update submit to work with it and return a Promise that settles after handling the outcome. Preserve the editor behavior, public methods and other consumers. Search preview is outside this change.
